# Worldpackers

> > Worldpackers is a global work exchange and volunteer travel platform connecting 7.6M+ travelers with hosts across 140+ countries for collaborative travel experiences.

The platform enables travelers to exchange skills for accommodation through verified hosts, offering opportunities across continents including the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Oceania. Worldpackers features WP Safeguard for traveler protection and emphasizes community-driven, safe collaborative travel for gap years and volunteer abroad experiences.

## Key Topics

- Work exchange programs
- Volunteer travel opportunities
- Gap year planning
- WP Safeguard (traveler protection)
- Host verification system
- Collaborative travel community
- Popular destinations: United States, Mexico, Costa Rica, Spain, Portugal, India
- Regional travel: South America, Central America, North America, Europe, Africa, Asia, Oceania
- Travel safety and security
- Skill-based exchanges
- Accommodation exchange
- Community platform for travelers
- International volunteering
- Budget travel solutions
- Cultural immersion experiences
